what_happened.line: The Select Board discussed with consultants which projects to bundle into a Complete Streets funding application, and the captions record no decision.
Members split over adding the Whalum area project and dropping item eight; the chair polled members one by one and the captions end before an outcome.
Dropping item eight and keeping items one, three and four would bring the request under the amount available, as heard.
A member asked why the town share differs for one project; the answer was that paving and drainage are not grant-eligible but count toward total project value.

why_it_matters: Which streets are in the application decides which sidewalk, crossing and road projects can draw state Complete Streets money instead of relying only on the town budget, mostly taxes.
Costs the grant does not cover, such as paving and drainage, stay with the town, so the mix of projects shapes the local share.
